title: Samsung Family Hub
description: Instructions on how to integrate Samsung Family Hub refrigerator cameras within Home Assistant.
body:
The **Samsung Family Hub** integration allows you to get images of the inside of your [Samsung Family Hub refrigerator](https://www.samsung.com/us/explore/family-hub-refrigerator/connected-hub/) in Home Assistant.

## Configuration

To enable your Family Hub camera in your installation, add the following to your `configuration.yaml` file.

```yaml
# Example configuration.yaml entry
camera:
  - platform: familyhub
    ip_address: "IP_ADDRESS"
```

```yaml
ip_address:
  description: The IP address of your refrigerator.
  required: true
  type: string
```
